name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
header:
Technical University of Munich (TUM)
Germany · MSc Mathematics; later doctorate after a qualifying master
European research-fit addition; not a US ranking entry.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Bachelor-only doctorate unavailable under current TUM guidance.
• VPD and TUMonline are separate applications with a special VPD grace period.
• Detailed course descriptions and a grade-conversion form are required.
• Winter 2027-28 tuition rises; tuition waivers do not supply a living stipend.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: bachelor in mathematics, physics or a comparable field, subject-equivalence assessment and aptitude
selection; a pending degree may apply with at least140 ECTS. UChicago eligibility depends on the course
mapping. Current Graduate School instructions explicitly exclude bachelor-only doctoral admission and say no
fast-track doctorate is offered; plan an MSc first. A later foreign master requires school recognition. [s1] [s2] [s5]
[s12] [s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Obtain TUM-specific VPD through uni-assist and submit a separate TUMonline application. Prepare the
curricular-analysis spreadsheet, detailed course guide and English evidence. APS is specified for degrees
obtained in China/India/Vietnam; a UChicago-earned degree does not meet that stated trigger merely because
of citizenship. If selected for stage2, attend a20-30 minute English interview, normally July/August for winter
entry, with at least one week notice. [s1] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior MSc supervisor commitment is listed. For a later doctorate, first find a supervisor and an actual
funding route; initial contact can include CV, master certificate, motivation, publication summaries and a
project proposal. Faculty listed below establish research fit, not an available 2027 funded position. [s1] [s12]
[s13]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use both My assist and TUMonline. Pay uni-assist by supported card/bank method and submit the request;
retain receipt/status confirmation. TUM-specific VPD is valid three years if underlying qualifications are
unchanged. A pending-VPD upload may show a negative document status until replaced; it does not waive the
final-VPD deadline. [s6] [s7]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Winter 2027-28 tuition increase is explicit and summer 2027 waiver forms are linked. Mathematics admission
dates otherwise remain standing annual instructions; exact 2027 portal-only prompts and individual offer
deadlines were not verified. [s1] [s2] [s8] [s10]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Conflict]
MSc winter: May 31; summer: November 30, standing annual closing dates. Winter opening conflicts:
department February 1, central catalogue January 1. Summer opens October 1. A separately dated 2027
mathematics cutoff clock was not established. A future doctorate has no central annual deadline, but
advertised funded posts do. [s1] [s2] [s12]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Incoming-MSc tuition-waiver applications: January 1-May 31 for winter, November 1-January 15 for summer.
Merit ranking certificates requiring paper verification must arrive by June 14/January 29 respectively. These are
standing dates; linked forms explicitly cover summer 2027. Smaller international-student grant:2027 call not
yet verified;2026 autumn application was October 1-15. [s10] [s11]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc has no reference deadline because references are not listed. Later international-student grant
permits reports/transcripts by November 15/May 15, after its main application deadline. No incoming-waiver
reference deadline was established from inaccessible forms. [s1] [s10] [s11]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English proof belongs in the MSc application by May 31/November 30. No GRE deadline is listed. A qualifying
English-medium record can replace a test; do not assume a late-test grace period. [s1] [s2]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All ordinary application uploads are due with the application. VPD exception: complete and pay the uni-assist
request before the academic deadline, upload the signed pending-VPD confirmation, then replace it with the
final VPD by July 15 for winter or February 15 for summer. Processing is normally4-6 weeks and aptitude review
waits for the actual VPD. [s6]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
No universal admission acceptance date was established; follow the TUMonline offer. Scholarship offers also
require acceptance by their individual deadline. First-enrollment fee payment is due September 15/March 15;
posting can take five business days. These payment dates are not a universal offer-response deadline. [s9] [s10]

English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc is English taught. Accepted alternatives include an English-medium prior degree, a graded thesis written

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No guaranteed MSc living stipend found. Incoming merit/need awards waive tuition, not living costs. The
separate international-student grant is EUR500-1800 per semester as a one-off award, not an annual
guaranteed stipend, and normally excludes first-semester MSc entrants from outside TUM. [s10] [s11]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Merit tuition waiver covers two semesters, with reapplication possible. Need-based waiver covers the standard
degree duration, with a possible two-semester extension on request. The small international grant can be
re-applied for, subject to its cumulative36-month limit. No guaranteed doctoral term or annual salary applies
without an employment/fellowship offer. [s10] [s11] [s13]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Non-EU fee-paying international MSc applicants are the target of the tuition-waiver schemes. A UChicago

degree does not itself confer EU fee status. Doctorates are exempt from the international tuition charge, but
bachelor-only admission is unavailable. [s8] [s10] [s12]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Tuition relief does not cover rent/living costs or automatically eliminate semester contributions. Merit requires
ranking evidence; need-based relief requires financial documentation. The small grant is normally available
from the second MSc semester, except first-semester entrants with a TUM bachelor, and considers need and
academic performance. [s10] [s11]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Submit a separate scholarship/waiver application after the academic application supplies an application
number. Where digital ranking verification is inadequate, paper originals must arrive by the separately stated
deadline. A future doctoral appointment is a separate job/funding arrangement from academic admission. [s10]
[s13]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
TUM lists external foundations and other scholarships; eligibility and amounts are award-specific. Student
employment or a future research-associate contract cannot be assumed from MSc admission. No universal
additional funding amount was established. [s9] [s13]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
uni-assist: EUR75 for the first application/VPD request and EUR30 for each additional programme in the same
semester. A separate TUMonline application charge was not established. Mathematics currently lists EUR6000
tuition/semester; TUM explicitly raises the EUR6000 master tier to EUR6800 from winter 2027-28. Thus
EUR6800/semester (EUR13600/year) is the inferred mathematics 2027 rate pending programme-specific
confirmation, plus the semester contribution (currently EUR97 at Garching;2027 unverified). [s2] [s7] [s8] [s9]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No uni-assist fee waiver for this applicant was verified. TUM tuition waivers are separate from application
processing fees; use the scholarship procedures above. F-1 status does not itself establish a German tuition
exemption. [s7] [s10]

Technical University of Munich (TUM)
Germany · MSc Mathematics; later doctorate after a qualifying master
European research-fit addition; not a US ranking entry.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Bachelor-only doctorate unavailable under current TUM guidance.
• VPD and TUMonline are separate applications with a special VPD grace period.
• Detailed course descriptions and a grade-conversion form are required.
• Winter 2027-28 tuition rises; tuition waivers do not supply a living stipend.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: bachelor in mathematics, physics or a comparable field, subject-equivalence assessment and aptitude
selection; a pending degree may apply with at least140 ECTS. UChicago eligibility depends on the course
mapping. Current Graduate School instructions explicitly exclude bachelor-only doctoral admission and say no
fast-track doctorate is offered; plan an MSc first. A later foreign master requires school recognition. [s1] [s2] [s5]
[s12] [s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Obtain TUM-specific VPD through uni-assist and submit a separate TUMonline application. Prepare the
curricular-analysis spreadsheet, detailed course guide and English evidence. APS is specified for degrees
obtained in China/India/Vietnam; a UChicago-earned degree does not meet that stated trigger merely because
of citizenship. If selected for stage2, attend a20-30 minute English interview, normally July/August for winter
entry, with at least one week notice. [s1] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior MSc supervisor commitment is listed. For a later doctorate, first find a supervisor and an actual
funding route; initial contact can include CV, master certificate, motivation, publication summaries and a
project proposal. Faculty listed below establish research fit, not an available 2027 funded position. [s1] [s12]
[s13]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use both My assist and TUMonline. Pay uni-assist by supported card/bank method and submit the request;
retain receipt/status confirmation. TUM-specific VPD is valid three years if underlying qualifications are
unchanged. A pending-VPD upload may show a negative document status until replaced; it does not waive the
final-VPD deadline. [s6] [s7]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Winter 2027-28 tuition increase is explicit and summer 2027 waiver forms are linked. Mathematics admission
dates otherwise remain standing annual instructions; exact 2027 portal-only prompts and individual offer
deadlines were not verified. [s1] [s2] [s8] [s10]

MSc winter: May 31; summer: November 30, standing annual closing dates. Winter opening conflicts:

mathematics cutoff clock was not established. A future doctorate has no central annual deadline, but
advertised funded posts do. [s1] [s2] [s12]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Incoming-MSc tuition-waiver applications: January 1-May 31 for winter, November 1-January 15 for summer.
Merit ranking certificates requiring paper verification must arrive by June 14/January 29 respectively. These are
standing dates; linked forms explicitly cover summer 2027. Smaller international-student grant:2027 call not
yet verified;2026 autumn application was October 1-15. [s10] [s11]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc has no reference deadline because references are not listed. Later international-student grant
permits reports/transcripts by November 15/May 15, after its main application deadline. No incoming-waiver
reference deadline was established from inaccessible forms. [s1] [s10] [s11]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English proof belongs in the MSc application by May 31/November 30. No GRE deadline is listed. A qualifying
English-medium record can replace a test; do not assume a late-test grace period. [s1] [s2]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All ordinary application uploads are due with the application. VPD exception: complete and pay the uni-assist
request before the academic deadline, upload the signed pending-VPD confirmation, then replace it with the
final VPD by July 15 for winter or February 15 for summer. Processing is normally4-6 weeks and aptitude review
waits for the actual VPD. [s6]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
No universal admission acceptance date was established; follow the TUMonline offer. Scholarship offers also
require acceptance by their individual deadline. First-enrollment fee payment is due September 15/March 15;
posting can take five business days. These payment dates are not a universal offer-response deadline. [s9] [s10]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc is English taught. Accepted alternatives include an English-medium prior degree, a graded thesis written
in English, or at least10 ECTS of English-taught modules, with documentary evidence. Doctoral admission itself
has no formal language-test minimum, although fluent research English is expected. [s1] [s12]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago English instruction should satisfy the published degree/module route if documented. Because a final
degree may still be pending, use official English-course evidence rather than assuming a future diploma
already proves the requirement. This is an application of the published rule, not an individual waiver decision.
[s1]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not listed for this pure Mathematics MSc. Requirements of Mathematics in Data Science or other TUM degrees
must not be transferred here. No universal doctoral GRE requirement is published. [s1] [s2] [s12]

analysis, English evidence, course guide, CV, motivation letter, passport/ID and VPD or permitted pending-VPD
confirmation. Enrollment can require additional final/certified documents; the individual portal checklist
controls. [s1] [s2] [s6]

credits and numeric grades; the spreadsheet converts them. For letter grades use official grade points where
available. Enter normal programme duration and total credits required to graduate, not personal elapsed time
or credits completed. Save the completed form as PDF. [s3] [s16]

Required English/German module handbook with content and skills; titles alone are insufficient. If no

descriptions where necessary. [s4]

Germany · MSc Mathematics; later doctorate after a qualifying master
European research-fit addition; not a US ranking entry.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written

Pay attention to
• Bachelor-only doctorate unavailable under current TUM guidance.
• VPD and TUMonline are separate applications with a special VPD grace period.
• Detailed course descriptions and a grade-conversion form are required.
• Winter 2027-28 tuition rises; tuition waivers do not supply a living stipend.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: bachelor in mathematics, physics or a comparable field, subject-equivalence assessment and aptitude
selection; a pending degree may apply with at least140 ECTS. UChicago eligibility depends on the course
mapping. Current Graduate School instructions explicitly exclude bachelor-only doctoral admission and say no
fast-track doctorate is offered; plan an MSc first. A later foreign master requires school recognition. [s1] [s2] [s5]
[s12] [s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Obtain TUM-specific VPD through uni-assist and submit a separate TUMonline application. Prepare the
curricular-analysis spreadsheet, detailed course guide and English evidence. APS is specified for degrees
obtained in China/India/Vietnam; a UChicago-earned degree does not meet that stated trigger merely because
of citizenship. If selected for stage2, attend a20-30 minute English interview, normally July/August for winter
entry, with at least one week notice. [s1] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior MSc supervisor commitment is listed. For a later doctorate, first find a supervisor and an actual
funding route; initial contact can include CV, master certificate, motivation, publication summaries and a
project proposal. Faculty listed below establish research fit, not an available 2027 funded position. [s1] [s12]
[s13]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use both My assist and TUMonline. Pay uni-assist by supported card/bank method and submit the request;
retain receipt/status confirmation. TUM-specific VPD is valid three years if underlying qualifications are
unchanged. A pending-VPD upload may show a negative document status until replaced; it does not waive the
final-VPD deadline. [s6] [s7]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Winter 2027-28 tuition increase is explicit and summer 2027 waiver forms are linked. Mathematics admission
dates otherwise remain standing annual instructions; exact 2027 portal-only prompts and individual offer
deadlines were not verified. [s1] [s2] [s8] [s10]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Conflict]
MSc winter: May 31; summer: November 30, standing annual closing dates. Winter opening conflicts:
department February 1, central catalogue January 1. Summer opens October 1. A separately dated 2027
mathematics cutoff clock was not established. A future doctorate has no central annual deadline, but
advertised funded posts do. [s1] [s2] [s12]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Incoming-MSc tuition-waiver applications: January 1-May 31 for winter, November 1-January 15 for summer.
Merit ranking certificates requiring paper verification must arrive by June 14/January 29 respectively. These are
standing dates; linked forms explicitly cover summer 2027. Smaller international-student grant:2027 call not
yet verified;2026 autumn application was October 1-15. [s10] [s11]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc has no reference deadline because references are not listed. Later international-student grant
permits reports/transcripts by November 15/May 15, after its main application deadline. No incoming-waiver
reference deadline was established from inaccessible forms. [s1] [s10] [s11]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English proof belongs in the MSc application by May 31/November 30. No GRE deadline is listed. A qualifying
English-medium record can replace a test; do not assume a late-test grace period. [s1] [s2]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All ordinary application uploads are due with the application. VPD exception: complete and pay the uni-assist
request before the academic deadline, upload the signed pending-VPD confirmation, then replace it with the
final VPD by July 15 for winter or February 15 for summer. Processing is normally4-6 weeks and aptitude review
waits for the actual VPD. [s6]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
No universal admission acceptance date was established; follow the TUMonline offer. Scholarship offers also
require acceptance by their individual deadline. First-enrollment fee payment is due September 15/March 15;
posting can take five business days. These payment dates are not a universal offer-response deadline. [s9] [s10]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc is English taught. Accepted alternatives include an English-medium prior degree, a graded thesis written
in English, or at least10 ECTS of English-taught modules, with documentary evidence. Doctoral admission itself
has no formal language-test minimum, although fluent research English is expected. [s1] [s12]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago English instruction should satisfy the published degree/module route if documented. Because a final
degree may still be pending, use official English-course evidence rather than assuming a future diploma
already proves the requirement. This is an application of the published rule, not an individual waiver decision.
[s1]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not listed for this pure Mathematics MSc. Requirements of Mathematics in Data Science or other TUM degrees
must not be transferred here. No universal doctoral GRE requirement is published. [s1] [s2] [s12]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not listed for this pure Mathematics MSc; no minimum or recommendation established. [s1] [s2]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload prior degree certificate if available, transcript documenting at least140 ECTS equivalent, curricular
analysis, English evidence, course guide, CV, motivation letter, passport/ID and VPD or permitted pending-VPD
confirmation. Enrollment can require additional final/certified documents; the individual portal checklist
controls. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required curricular-analysis form: best-graded118 ECTS plus22 ECTS of additional courses. Enter original
credits and numeric grades; the spreadsheet converts them. For letter grades use official grade points where
available. Enter normal programme duration and total credits required to graduate, not personal elapsed time
or credits completed. Save the completed form as PDF. [s3] [s16]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Required English/German module handbook with content and skills; titles alone are insufficient. If no
institutional guide exists, obtain confirmation and assemble descriptions/lecture contents or official links.
Self-written descriptions need a professor’s signature and university stamp. Include originals with translated
descriptions where necessary. [s4]

Number and type [Standing rule]
No recommendation letters appear on the ordinary MSc required-document list. Do not prepare three letters by

Later small international-student grant requires two lecturer reports no more than one semester old. The
startup-based merit-waiver route, generally relevant later, uses a professor and an entrepreneurship adviser;

referee questions remain unverified. [s10] [s11] [s29] [s30]

Not applicable to ordinary MSc. Scholarship applications require the TUM application number obtained after

Ordinary MSc: not applicable. The later international grant limits report age to one semester; automatic reuse

Academic CV required for MSc; no public length/font limit identified. Doctoral initial contact also requests a CV.
[s1] [s12]

MSc motivation letter in English, maximum 1-2 pages. Address academic/career goals, why this TUM

programme, relevant skills and preparation beyond the basic curriculum such as internships, study abroad and
additional courses; supporting evidence may be attached. This is a paraphrase of the instructions; the linked

No separate personal/background essay listed for the ordinary MSc. [s1]

No MSc research proposal listed. For a later eligible doctoral application, the Graduate School recommends a

No mandatory MSc writing sample or thesis upload established; a graded English thesis can instead serve as

Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate MSc publications list or paper-upload requirement found. Later doctoral contact asks for

Required curricular-analysis PDF and course guide; see the academic-record entries. The competency checklist
requires at least36 ECTS across the listed advanced topics, including analysis, probability, algebra, geometry,
complex/function analysis, optimization, numerics and differential equations; use the exact official checklist for

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No guaranteed MSc living stipend found. Incoming merit/need awards waive tuition, not living costs. The
separate international-student grant is EUR500-1800 per semester as a one-off award, not an annual
guaranteed stipend, and normally excludes first-semester MSc entrants from outside TUM. [s10] [s11]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Merit tuition waiver covers two semesters, with reapplication possible. Need-based waiver covers the standard
degree duration, with a possible two-semester extension on request. The small international grant can be
re-applied for, subject to its cumulative36-month limit. No guaranteed doctoral term or annual salary applies
without an employment/fellowship offer. [s10] [s11] [s13]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Non-EU fee-paying international MSc applicants are the target of the tuition-waiver schemes. A UChicago

degree does not itself confer EU fee status. Doctorates are exempt from the international tuition charge, but
bachelor-only admission is unavailable. [s8] [s10] [s12]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Tuition relief does not cover rent/living costs or automatically eliminate semester contributions. Merit requires
ranking evidence; need-based relief requires financial documentation. The small grant is normally available
from the second MSc semester, except first-semester entrants with a TUM bachelor, and considers need and
academic performance. [s10] [s11]

Submit a separate scholarship/waiver application after the academic application supplies an application

deadline. A future doctoral appointment is a separate job/funding arrangement from academic admission. [s10]
